value.rationale: The main 2026 exact H4 first-shift paper presents non-strict bounds for every higher iterate, leaving an explicit quantitative second-iterate gap. This identifies the unique sharp lift of all known first extremizers after a natural free constant correction and proves strict norm increase at the first power step. The complete, nonarbitrary family classification ties operator-norm extremizers to Schwarz--Pick rigidity and yields a potentially useful concrete benchmark for future exact B² norm studies.
